with
    group_orders as (
        select
            cast(orderid as string) as order_id,
            coalesce(cast(clientndk as string), email_hash, phone_hash) as user_id,
            user_id as crm_user_id,
            email_hash,
            phone_hash,
            cast(clientNDK as string) as clientNDK,
            channel,
            cast(timestamp_order as int64) as timestamp_order,
            cast(price_with_disc as float64) as amount_with_discount,
            cast(without_discount as float64) as amount_without_discount,
            is_new,
            is_new_by_phone,
        from `letual-143615`.`MA`.`Daily_orders_data_Mtrendo`
        where certificate = 0
        qualify
            row_number() over (partition by order_id order by timestamp_order desc) = 1
    ),
    result as (
        select
            TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(timestamp_order) as order_time,
            date(TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(timestamp_order)) as order_date,
            user_id,
            order_id,
            amount_with_discount as revenue,
            amount_without_discount as revenue_without_discount,
            crm_user_id,
            email_hash,
            phone_hash,
            clientNDK,
            case
                when channel = 'Мобильное приложение iOS'
                then 'app'
                when channel = 'Мобильное приложение Android'
                then 'app'
                when channel = 'Мобильная версия сайта ИМ'
                then 'web'
                when channel = 'Полная версия сайта ИМ'
                then 'web'
                else null
            end as crm_touchpoint,
            case
                when channel = 'Мобильное приложение iOS'
                then 'iOS'
                when channel = 'Мобильное приложение Android'
                then 'Android'
                when channel = 'Мобильная версия сайта ИМ'
                then 'web_mobile'
                when channel = 'Полная версия сайта ИМ'
                then 'web_full'
                else null
            end as crm_operatingsystem,
            is_new = 1 as is_new,
            is_new_by_phone = 1 as is_new_by_phone
        from group_orders
    )

select *
from result
